current_state.text: Signed documents are currently maintained without automated audit records or REST API integration.
Historic records are held in the current tool without automated migration.

target_state.text: The Supplier keeps an audit record of every signature event and stores signed documents for ten years.
The service integrates with the College's student records system through its existing REST API.
Historic records are migrated with trial runs, reconciliation reports and a final cut-over.

workstreams.name: Electronic Signing and Integration
workstreams.objective: Configure electronic signing, document retention, and student record system integration.

workstreams.name: Partner Implementation
workstreams.objective: Manage the live deployment timeline with the implementation partner.

work_packages.name: Signing and Storage
work_packages.deliverable: Audit records, browser support, reminders, templates, 10-year storage, and on-premises deployment option
work_packages.scope: Configure audit records, browser support, reminders, templates, ten-year storage, and on-premises deployment options.
work_packages.exclusions: Service availability and severity-one incident response requirements.
work_packages.acceptance: Signed documents are stored for ten years with complete audit records and configured features.

effort.basis_text: Similar signing and storage configurations took comparable time ranges.

work_packages.name: Integration and Migration
work_packages.deliverable: REST API integration and historic record migration
work_packages.scope: Implement REST API integration with the student records system and execute historic record migration.
work_packages.exclusions: Custom modifications outside the documented REST API.
work_packages.acceptance: Historic records are migrated with trial runs and reconciliation reports, and the REST API exchanges data successfully.

effort.basis_text: Based on previous API integrations and data migrations.
effort.uncertainty: Data quality in the legacy system.

work_packages.name: Timeline Execution
work_packages.scope: Manage the live deployment timeline with the implementation partner to ensure go-live.
work_packages.exclusions: Proposal submission instructions and portal requirements.
work_packages.acceptance: Service is deployed live with partner assistance by the target date.

effort.basis_text: Standard timeline management duration for partner deployments.

assumptions.text: A third-party implementation partner can bridge timeline and attribute release gaps.
Proposal submission instructions and portal requirements are excluded from the solution scope.
Service availability and severity-one incident response requirements are excluded from the first release.

ground_rules.text: Document retention follows the ten-year period stated in the RFP.

tech_claims.text: The service provides a documented REST API for exchanging data with other line-of-business systems.
The service provides migration of historic records and documents, with trial runs, reconciliation reports and a final cut-over.

benefits.hypothesis: Staff complete signature workflows faster and maintain secure audit trails.
benefits.measure: Time taken to complete signature workflows and audit log completeness.

benefits.hypothesis: The service is deployed on schedule with partner assistance.
benefits.measure: Actual go-live date compared to target.

win_themes.metric: Successful data exchange with line-of-business systems
win_themes.benefit: Seamless integration with the College's student records system

win_themes.metric: Trial runs, reconciliation reports, and cut-over completeness
win_themes.benefit: Historic records are successfully migrated without loss

pdca.plan: Plan the configuration of signing, retention, API, and migration.
pdca.do: Execute signing setup, ten-year storage, REST API integration, and trial migrations.
pdca.check: Verify audit records, reconciliation reports, and API data exchange.
pdca.act: Refine configurations based on check findings.

pdca.plan: Establish the deployment timeline with the implementation partner.
pdca.do: Coordinate deployment tasks and partner assistance.
pdca.check: Review milestone progress against the schedule.
pdca.act: Adjust coordination activities to bridge timeline gaps.
